commit.source: the build metadata of the version

package.source: the agentsplice-win-x64 artifact of the CI run for that commit, run 38987013797

packageSha256.source: the artifact's SHA256SUMS, checked with sha256sum --check --strict before extracting

configuration.value: appsettings.json as the package ships it, and one argument: --agentsplice:administration:apiKeyEnvironmentVariable=AGENTSPLICE_ADMIN_API_KEY, naming a variable that held a token generated for these sessions
configuration.source: the command that started the gateway

contentCapture.source: GET /api/v1/system: contentRetentionEnabled; agentsplice:capture:contentEnabled and agentsplice:diagnostics:storeBodies are false in the shipped appsettings.json

gpuMemory.source: the display adapter's HardwareInformation.qwMemorySize registry value

engine.source: lms runtime ls, the selected engine

server.value: http://127.0.0.1:1234, started for these sessions and stopped after them

quantization.value: APEX I-Compact, with an importance matrix; the GGUF header's file type is 15, mostly Q4_K_M
quantization.source: the file name, and the GGUF header: general.file_type and quantize.imatrix.*

parallel.source: LM Studio's default, not set on the command line; lms ps --json: parallel

flashAttention.source: not set on the command line, no saved configuration for this file, and neither lms ps nor the server log reports it

kvCacheType.source: not set on the command line, no saved configuration for this file, and neither lms ps nor the server log reports it

speculativeDecoding.source: no speculative option on the command line

threads.source: LM Studio's server log: llama threadpool init

bytes.source: the model file's size; lms ls --json reports 14997460672, the model and its projector together

visionProjector.value: mmproj-F32.gguf, 1786305248 bytes, loaded with the model

sha256.source: sha256sum of the model file, not the projector

architecture.value: qwen35moe, 40 blocks with full attention every fourth, 256 experts with 8 used

contextLength.source: the saved per-model configuration in LM Studio; lms ps --json: contextLength

parallel.source: the saved per-model configuration; lms ps --json: parallel

kvCacheType.source: the saved per-model configuration: llm.load.llama.kCacheQuantizationType and vCacheQuantizationType

threads.source: LM Studio's server log: llama threadpool init

invocation.value: opencode run --format json --model agentsplice/<model id> "<prompt>", with stdin closed, from a new directory holding calc.py and opencode.json
invocation.source: the script that ran each attempt

limit.context: <the context length the model was loaded with>

configuration.source: opencode.json in each attempt's directory, from examples/opencode/opencode.json, with the model's display name generalized: attempts 1 and 2 named it 'Qwen3 Coder 30B through AgentSplice' and 'Qwen3.6 35B A3B through AgentSplice', a name OpenCode does not send; the account's global OpenCode configuration holds only $schema

environment.value: Attempts 1 and 2 ran with OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR pointing at a terminal integration's own configuration directory, which holds a plugin; attempts 3 and 4 ran with that directory and the integration's variables unset. In every attempt that reached OpenCode's agent, it found 18 skills, 17 installed for the account and one built in, and every agent request carried their descriptions in its system message: 15,322 characters, about 63% of that message, and between 35% and 39% of each agent request's body. The title requests carry none.
environment.source: OpenCode's own log, which shows that directory's configuration loading in attempts 1 and 2 only, and 'init count=18' in attempts 1, 3, and 4; the directory itself, which holds a plugins folder; LM Studio's server log of the request bodies, read for their structure only

prompt.value: calc.py's mean() returns the wrong result. Fix the bug, then add test_calc.py with unittest tests for mean() and clamp(). Do not run any commands. Session marker: <a random trace-canary-* marker, different for each attempt>.
prompt.source: the script that ran each attempt

startingFiles.value: calc.py, as reproduced in README.md, and opencode.json
startingFiles.source: the script that ran each attempt
